benefits.title: Docs Nobody Reads Become Instant Answers in Chat
benefits.body: Users rarely open the documentation, they message you instead. Cekat.AI trains on your docs, FAQs, and knowledge base, then answers feature, pricing, and how-to questions in natural language within seconds. Update the docs once and the AI answers with the latest version, no more three admins giving three different answers.
benefits.imageAlt: Product knowledge base powering AI answers in Cekat.AI

benefits.title: Trial Users Guided to Activation, Not Left to Drift
benefits.body: Most trial users quit before they ever feel the value of your product. Cekat.AI greets new signups, answers setup questions at the exact moment they get stuck, and sends automated WhatsApp follow-ups based on each user's journey, so more trials reach the aha moment instead of silently disappearing on day two.
benefits.imageAlt: Trial user journey tracked in the Cekat.AI CRM

benefits.title: Bug Reports Turn Into Tickets for Engineering
benefits.body: Bugs reported in chat tend to vanish before they reach an engineer. Cekat.AI converts bug reports into tickets automatically, complete with the user's chronology, and routes them to the right team. Engineering gets full context without joining the support rotation, and users can ask for a status update anytime.
benefits.imageAlt: Bug reports automatically converted into tickets in Cekat.AI

benefits.title: Complex Cases Hand Over to Your Team, Context Included
benefits.body: The AI handles the repetitive questions, your team handles what needs a human. When a sensitive billing case or an enterprise request comes in, the conversation hands over to a human agent with the full history attached, the user never repeats themselves, and engineers only get pulled in when it is truly needed.
benefits.imageAlt: Conversation escalating from AI to a human agent in Cekat.AI

benefits.title: Know What Users Ask, and How Satisfied They Leave
benefits.body: Every conversation becomes data. See the topics users ask about most, where they get stuck, and the CSAT score of each interaction, so roadmap calls and onboarding fixes start from real user conversations instead of guesses in a meeting.

faq.q: How does Cekat.AI help SaaS companies?
faq.a: It answers product questions instantly 24/7 on web chat, WhatsApp, and social media, guides trial users to activation, and turns bug reports into organized tickets. Your small CS team focuses on cases that need a human, and engineers stay out of the support rotation.

faq.q: How does the AI learn our product?
faq.a: Paste your documentation, FAQs, changelog, and SOPs into the knowledge base and the AI answers from that material. When the product changes, update the knowledge base once and the answers update with it, no retraining projects, no waiting on engineering.

faq.q: Can it help onboard trial users?
faq.a: Yes. The AI greets new signups, answers setup questions at the moment they get stuck, and sends automated follow-ups on WhatsApp based on each user's behavior. The goal is simple, more trial users experiencing your product's value before the trial runs out.

Bug reports from chat become tickets automatically, complete with the user's chronology and details, then route to the right team. You track every ticket's status in one view, so no bug drowns in the inbox and users hear back the moment it is fixed.

faq.q: When does a conversation hand over from AI to our team?
faq.a: By rules you define, for example billing cases, refund requests, or an enterprise prospect asking for a demo. The AI hands the conversation to the right agent with full history attached, so users never have to start their story over.

Yes. CSAT is measured from conversations, and the analytics dashboard shows the most asked topics, peak hours, and how AI and human agents perform. You learn where users get stuck and which parts of the product generate the most questions.

faq.q: How is our user data secured?
faq.a: Conversation and customer data is stored securely with role-based access, visible only to team members you authorize. ISO 27001 certification is in progress, and data practices follow industry standards.

faq.q: How long does setup take? Do we need engineering time?
faq.a: Building the AI agent takes around five minutes, paste your product docs and FAQs into the knowledge base, install the web chat widget, and it starts answering. No coding to get started, with API integration available when you want to connect data from your app.

faq.q: How does pricing work for an early-stage SaaS?
faq.a: Pricing follows usage, so you can start on a small plan while your user base is small and scale up as you grow. Book a free consultation and our team will help size a plan that matches your conversation volume.
